title: Creative Brief
description: Schema for creative/image/video/design briefs produced by the Creative Asset Agent.

brand_id.description: Brand identifier. Default: VQ for Vị Cuốn.

asset_type.description: Type of creative asset to produce.

format.description: Aspect ratio and resolution. E.g., 9:16 vertical 1080x1920, 1:1 square 1080x1080.

visual_direction.description: Detailed visual direction: mood, color palette, lighting, shot composition.

scene_description.description: Scene-by-scene description for video assets. Null for static assets.

copy_overlay.description: Text overlay or subtitle copy to appear on-screen.

ai_tool_prompt.description: AI image or video generation prompt. Safe for use with Midjourney, DALL-E, Kling, etc.

required_inputs.description: List of inputs required before production. E.g., real food photos, brand colors confirmation.
example: Real dish photography of Bánh Tráng Cuốn Thịt Heo

output_specs.description: Delivery spec: file format, resolution, duration if video.

qa_checklist.description: QA items to verify before marking Ready for Review.
example: No hardcoded prices without Owner confirmation

created_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this brief was created.

notes.description: Optional notes for the Owner or Reviewer.
